agents.title: Agents
agents.sub_before_link: Create an AI agent. It runs on your connected provider
agents.sub_after_link: , can use tools, and writes results back into your knowledge graph.
agents.shifts_hint: Each role has a standing brief. When it is on shift, the agent wakes up on its own, with its own skills.
agents.shift_stale: This role has no standing brief any more. The agent is still running the old one.
agents.no_duty: None of your agents has a standing brief yet.
agents.name: Name
agents.capabilities_ph: e.g. search vault, summarize, write weekly brief
agents.prompt_ph: Search the vault for changes this week and write a 3-bullet brief. Call write_artifact when done.
agents.cron_hint: With a cron + prompt, the scheduler wakes it automatically. Leave them blank for an on-demand agent.
